project_type: Node.js monorepo with npm workspaces - digital employee system with vanilla TS frontend + Node.js backend
build_system: npm workspaces, tsc for compilation, no bundler. Frontend TS compiles to public/*.js via tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json
test_framework: node:test + node:assert/strict, 233 test files in apps/ajun-runtime/test/, tests run with `node --test`
build_command: npm run check (runs architecture check + tsc + frontend build + typescript-ratio gate)
test_command: npm test (pretest runs check, then node --test in each workspace)
verification_instructions: 1. npm run check (architecture + tsc + frontend build), 2. npm test (full suite), 3. npm run test:affected for partial
snapshot_or_generated_files: apps/ajun-runtime/public/*.js are tsc output from frontend/src/*.ts - tracked in git, tests import them. Must run npm run build:frontend after changing frontend .ts files.
environment_constraints: Node.js 22.23.2 available. Open internet. No Docker needed for validation. tsconfig uses erasableSyntaxOnly: true (no enums/namespaces). Frontend compiles to ES2022 modules.
contribution_requirements: Must run npm run check after changes. Must run npm run test:affected. Secrets never in code. Don't delete existing capabilities. public/*.js must remain tracked.
key_patterns: Frontend: vanilla TS with innerHTML + manual escapeHtml() for DOM. CSS custom properties for theming. Tests use node:test with describe/it pattern. Architecture boundaries enforced by scripts/check-architecture-boundaries.mjs. Repository catalog in repository-catalog.json.
directory_structure: Root: monorepo with apps/, agents/, integrations/, packages/, scripts/, ops/, docs/, tasks/. Key apps: ajun-runtime (main runtime, 326 .ts files in src/, 19 .ts files in frontend/src/), project-progress-board (1 frontend .ts), xiaod-media-transcriber (1 frontend .ts). packages/ has m5-contracts and paperclip-client.
